title: Dissappointed!
text: Dissappointed!  My box was full of shredded paper.  I had to dig thru to find a few items in the small box.  There are 2 soap bars that claim to be scented, neither I or my hubbie could smell them.  A couple of nice bath bombs that were nicely scented but appear homemade.  A eye mask with no label so have no idea what I'm putting on my skin.  I canceled my subscription within minutes of opening and regret the purchase.  I subscribe to other subscription boxes and usually feel like I've gotten what I paid for.  I just felt cheated with this box, overpriced!
label: negative
